thread:
sre_jamal: :rotating_light: SLO alert p99 spike on hosted-infer generate endpoint in us-west2, started ~15m ago. Alert shows 5xx and timeouts. Customer CS-1248 escalated.
support_raj: Customer (acme-inc) reporting intermittent 500s and long tails on /v1/generate. They see errors ~6-10% of requests for some keys.
ingrid: seeing same in dashboards — per-route p50 ok, p95 elevated, p99 and 5xx up. Probe vs real traffic diverging.
alexa: query I ran: ```service:gateway env:prod region:us-west2 path:/v1/generate status:[500 TO 599] @timestamp:>=now-30m | top(route) | count by host``` lots coming from proxy-node-12 and model-proxy-7
ops_ana: I can restart the proxy on that host. Before that, any recent deploys? deploy-bot: Deployment "model-routing-v2" finished by ci/cd at 3777768000 :white_check_mark:
pm_ryan: rolled model-routing-v2 yesterday to 10% traffic in us-west2 — could be rollout-related.
tracing-bot: Traces show a gap: gateway -> model-proxy spans missing KV-cache fetch spans for many requests. Trace ids: trace-0a1b2c... (sampled). Possible KV cache backend timeouts.
sre_jamal: good find. If KV timeouts, fallback path may be hitting a slower code path causing timeouts and 5xx. Can someone pull redis/kv metrics for model-proxy from last hour?
alexa: redis latency spike at ~3777769200, p99 ~120ms -> 2s, concurrent errors on model-proxy logs show `ERR_TIMEOUT: kv fetch failed`.
support_raj: customer notes 500s started ~14:05 PST which matches the redis spike.
ingrid: mitigation idea: reduce model-proxy parallelism to avoid cascading failures and enable circuit breaker to fail fast to 503s instead of timeouts.
ops_ana: I pushed a temporary config to model-proxy pool (reduce concurrency to 8) on proxy-12 and restarted model-proxy-7. Watchers?
sre_jamal: thanks. Also toggled route failover to fallback-model-quantized in us-west2 for 1m to shed load.
tracing-bot: after restart/rollback spans show reduced tail latency, trace gap coverage improved from 40% -> 82% for sampled traces.
pm_ryan: rolling back routing-v2 to 0% in us-west2 now (started at 3777773000). Will notify.
support_raj: I updated CS-1248 with rollback and mitigation steps. Customer pinged back: errors lowered, still seeing occasional 500s.
ingrid: follow-up action: add alert on kv p99 > 100ms and add circuit-breaker metric alert on model-proxy. Also add dashboard panel linking kv errors -> gateway 5xx.
alexa: saved the query to dashboards as "hosted-infer /v1/generate kv-correlation" and added logs link to trace ids.
ops_ana: I'm also scheduling a full node health check for proxy-node-12; circling in infra to check NIC/IO.
pm_ryan: plan: (1) rotate KV cluster in us-west2 if we see recurring spikes, (2) tighten rollback rollouts for routing-v2, (3) add automated fallback window for model routing.
sre_jamal: ok. For the postmortem: collect traces showing pre/post restart, kv metrics, model-proxy logs, and customer request ids. Tagging follow-ups in #postmortems.
support_raj: assigning CS-1248 follow-up to me and product (pm_ryan). Customer wants RCA and mitigation timeline. :thumbsup:
ingrid: quick repro steps recorded:

```
# repro (low-rate)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# run for 10k requests churned across keys in us-west2 -> watch 5xx and kv timeout logs on model-proxy
```
tracing-bot: saved sample traces to trace-log-377777 for later analysis.
sre_jamal: great. I'll keep the channel open for another hour, will escalate to infra on recurrence. Thanks everyone for fast triage. :wave:
